description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in terms of the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage as a function of the number of data points (N). The x-axis, labeled "N," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)", is also a linear scale ranging from 75% to 100%, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot features five lines, each representing a different model, with distinct colors and marker shapes. The blue line, marked with circles, starts at an AUC of approximately 95% at N=0 and peaks at around 100% at N=5 before gradually declining to about 90% at N=20. The orange line, marked with squares, begins at an AUC of about 85% at N=0, rises to just over 90% at N=5, and then fluctuates, ending at around 85% at N=20. The green line, marked with triangles, starts at an AUC of approximately 90% at N=0, increases to about 95% at N=5, and then decreases to around 90% at N=20. The red line, marked with diamonds, begins at an AUC of around 85% at N=0, climbs to just below 95% at N=5, and then falls to about 85% at N=20. Lastly, the purple line, marked with inverted triangles, starts at an AUC of about 80% at N=0, sharply increases to just below 100% at N=5, and then drops to around 80% at N=20.
